title: KestrelCare Activation and the Limit of Liability
content:
**1. Activation.** Coverage under KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts starts on the coverage start date and odometer recorded on the plan; a plan sold with the vehicle activates when the vehicle is handed over. On activation the plan's status moves from pending to active.

**2. Opening the limit.** At activation the limit of liability is opened at the lesser of the plan's aggregate limit and the vehicle price on the purchase order. The limit is opened only on a plan whose status is active, as the service contract record shows it.

**3. The coverage remaining.** The coverage remaining is the limit of liability still available for repair claims: it is established at activation, reduced by claim payments and restored by payments recovered.

**4. End of the plan.** The plan expires at the earlier of its expiration date and its expiration odometer, and ends as exhausted when claim payments bring the coverage remaining to zero.

| Event on the plan | Effect on the coverage remaining | Status |
|---|---|---|
| activation | opened at the lesser of the aggregate limit and the vehicle price | pending to active |
| claim payment | reduced by the amount paid | active; exhausted when it reaches zero |
| payment recovered | restored by the amount recovered | unchanged |
| expiration date or expiration odometer reached, whichever is first | none | active to expired |

## Worked example (hypothetical plan)

A KestrelCare Gold plan (aggregate limit 20000.00) is activated on a vehicle whose purchase order shows a vehicle price of 16750.00. The limit opened is 16750.00. After claim payments of 3200.00 and 1100.00 the coverage remaining is 12450.00; a recovery of 300.00 brings it back to 12750.00.

A plan with an expiration date of 30 June and an expiration odometer of 86000 whose vehicle reaches 86000 miles on 12 April expires on 12 April, the earlier of the two.
